title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode15 Now and Forever More

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that idol me was able to return to her SEKAI safely.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Also...)
Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're all here...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Were all your other selves sent off to other SEKAI too?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, but they all managed to return home safely.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It was worth going over to check up on them♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it was. I was honestly a little worried at first...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that me got along so quickly with everyone from a different SEKAI. She did a live performance and roped in all those around her, which was very fun to watch.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. It was a little weird watching two different mes from different SEKAI talking... But it made me happy seeing them make friends.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I really wasn't expecting everyone to be sent to different SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know, right?! Not only that, all at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Normally, they wouldn't be able to visit a different SEKAI outside of their own.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The trees in each SEKAI must have something to do with all this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You may be right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Especially since everyone who was sent away was taking care of their tree at the time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Many things have happened with those SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We were able to meet everyone from those SEKAI through those fragments of feelings. And those trees were also born out of their feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They began as little sprouts, but grew big with the help of everyone's feelings. Not only did they show them those strange dreams, they caused this incident to happen too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Who knows what else could happen in the future?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you think they'll cause more weird things to happen?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For some reason, I don't think it'll be anything bad.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. After all, what happened today was very strange, but everyone seemed to have so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Whatever comes their way, I'm sure they'll be fine as long as they work together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's hard to say what's going to happen to their SEKAI moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But let's keep watching over them.
